# sextant-movers ecosystem index

The fastest path from a question to the page that answers it. Generated from the
tree by `scripts/ecosystem_index.py`; run `just session-start` to check it.

## Start here

- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md) — One focus: rank the US equity movers as they start, and show that rank in TradingView. The ranking (score engine, time-of-day volume baseline, generation, publisher, reader,...
- [Design](docs/design.md) — Rank the US equity names most likely to become extreme movers, as they start, in every supported session, and show that rank to the owner in TradingView. The rank is a display...
- [Manifest](docs/manifest.md) — What we do and where the practice comes from. Nothing enters the harness without a row. A practice we stop using is deleted; git keeps the history. `just prove` runs every proof...
- [Philosophy](docs/handbook/philosophy.md) — It ranks market movers and shows the ranking on TradingView. Sextant installs it at a pinned commit. The display is display only and never a signal.
- [Practices](docs/handbook/practices.md) — *The working practices that survived the harvest. Each line names the record it comes from; a practice with no source is dropped.*

## Decisions

- [ADR-0001: Sextant is built only from SOTA sources](docs/adr/0001-sextant-foundation.md) — The earlier campaign measured 8,393 tracked files, about 71 KB of rules per session, 17 hook entries, 108 deny rules, 1,130 open beads and 64 open PRs (northstar...
- [ADR-0002: sextant-movers is a clean, one-way package for the ranking and its display](docs/adr/0002-movers-foundation.md) — In Sextant the ranking and the TradingView display are about 10,350 source lines that import its execution, data, Alpaca and paper packages in both directions, and every change...
- [ADR-0003: TradingView displays the rank and never drives anything](docs/adr/0003-tradingview-display.md) — TradingView is the owner's main display of the rank, charts and notifications. It is never the ranking universe, and its data is never truth for anything. Broker and engine data...
